colourstrue-g3-mode-banks.title: ColoursTrue LG G3 picture-mode catalogue and calibration-bank separation
colourstrue-g3-mode-banks.use: Catalogue updated 2026-08-02, referencing r98 bank probes and r100/r101 mode selection evidence. HDR Cinema Home (hdrCinemaBright) is selectable but has no proved externalpq bank; HDR Cinema is a distinct calibrated preset. Generic workflow admission retains PGenerator's established supported families, not proof of every TV's support.

calibrator-forum-asbl-practice.title: Calibrator forum practice: disable ASBL (TPC/GSR) during LG OLED measurement
calibrator-forum-asbl-practice.url: local:ColoursTrue/References (calibration-software user forum thread, not in the tree)
calibrator-forum-asbl-practice.use: Static patterns dim after about 60 s with panel protection on; calibrators switch TPC and GSR off for the session and back on afterwards. Pattern insertion is the alternative mitigation.
